title: nf-core/stamp pipeline - params.input schema
description: Schema for the file provided with params.input

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

fastq_1.errorMessage: fastq_1: must be a valid .fastq.gz or .fq.gz file path with no spaces

fastq_2.errorMessage: fastq_2: must be a valid .fastq.gz or .fq.gz file path with no spaces

bam.errorMessage: bam: must be a valid .bam file path with no spaces

library_type.errorMessage: library_type must be 'SE' (single-end) or 'PE' (paired-end). Required for --mode bulk.

fastq_dir.errorMessage: fastq_dir: directory path for 10x Genomics FASTQs (SAMPLE_S1_L001_R1_001.fastq.gz naming required).

matrix_dir.errorMessage: matrix_dir: path to CellRanger filtered_feature_bc_matrix directory.
